description: Read the notes (הערות) attached to a single record. entityType is 'contact', 'lead' or 'case': for 'contact' pass the contact's phone number as entityId; for 'lead'/'case' pass the record id. Returns the notes newest-first (each with note, createdOn, createdById, createdByName).

entityId.description: Contact phone number (for 'contact') or the lead/case id.

entityType.description: Which record type the notes belong to.

name: gambot_get_entity_notes
title: Get notes for one record
